$description: Phase FL.10 (2026-11-16): conversations with a companion pack (agent.mode "companion"): a persona that chats from its notes and takes one of its steps only when the sentence asks. Each scenario is a list of turns run through the chat's own view model on the iOS simulator (AgentEvalHarness, Apple's on-device model); steps are evaluations unless `real`. Per turn: `expect` (steps that must run), `noStep` (an ordinary turn: none may run), `mustSay` / `mustNotSay` (regular expressions on the whole message shown), `offer` (a regular expression the one offer line must match) and `noOffer`. Every turn is also checked for more than one offer and for advice language. Runner and scorer: mchatai_macOS/LocalLLM/scripts/companion_flywheel.py. A `real` scenario holds only steps that write nothing (the source page, the quiz): the simulator is signed in to the owner's iCloud, so a real to-do or episode would land in his synced lists. Read the replies, not just the count.
